                <span class="temperature">15,8</span> 
                <span class="temperatureUnit">°C</span>
            </span>
            <span class="temp-update">
                (<span class="temperatureLastUpdate">12 okt, 23u12</span>)
            </span>
        </div>
        </p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>

						<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
					<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-66 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-b23a18a" data-id="b23a18a" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column">
			<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1ec7fd0 elementor-widget elementor-widget-image" data-id="1ec7fd0" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="image.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h3 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Lakeside Paradise Sport Hostel offers the ideal mix of privacy and a fun, relaxed atmosphere. </h3>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-b036ac5 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="b036ac5" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>You can retreat to the comfort of a family room or have fun with the kids in the city, at the beach or in nature. Our family-friendly hostel was created with the aim of providing a fun experience at the seaside! </p><p><em>We wish you a pleasant stay @ Paradise!</em></p>								</div>
				</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>For overnight stays in our hostel, reservations must always be made in advance.</p><p>Young people &lt;18 years old must be accompanied by a parent/guardian who will sleep in the room during the whole stay!</p>								</div>
				</div>
